title: TCL 43S450F-CA (TCL S4 Fire TV Edition, Amazon model AFTDEC012E, codename ginza), Fire OS 8.1.8.5 (RS8185/3885),
header:
TCL 43S450F-CA (TCL S4 Fire TV Edition, Amazon model AFTDEC012E, codename ginza), Fire OS 8.1.8.5 (RS8185/3885),
Android 11 (SDK 30), MediaTek, ATSC tuner, 1.8 GB RAM, Canada. Spanish UI.
Same firmware line as hisense-fire-tv-aftcibfbd1 (Fire OS 8.0 TV) and amazon-fire-tv-stick-4k-2023 (Fire OS 8.1.8.5).

FIRE OS: DEBLOAT ONLY. Home is com.amazon.tv.launcher/.ui.HomeActivity_vNext (priority 950), with
com.amazon.firehomestarter (priority 1) behind it; both are protected on Fire OS 8, so launcher/ does not take Home.
HDMI input switching is reserved to Amazon-signed apps (com.amazon.tv.permission.TUNE_INPUT).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-43s450f-ca/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-43s450f-ca/debloat.txt com.amazon.tv.launcher
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Kept on purpose (owner's choice): Prime Video (com.amazon.firebat, tv.support, imp, ottssocompanionapp), Amazon Music
(bueller.music), Luna (gamehub), Alexa voice and its services (vizzini, aria, alexa*, aca, aiondec, audiohome,
rtcsessioncontroller, spotify.mediabrowserservice, androidskillconnectioncapability), AirPlay, Miracast (cast.sink),
DIAL casting (dialservice, whisperplay, whisperlink, awvflingreceiver), OTA updates (device.software.ota*,
tv.forcedotaupdater.v2), Tubi, Pluto TV, Netflix, YouTube, Spotify, Stremio, Nuvio, NordVPN, Downloader.
Always kept: Live TV and tuner (tv.livetv, mediatek.livetv, mediatek.dtv.tvinput.*, tv.channelscan, franktvinput),
settings, quick settings, IME, remote/Bluetooth, Appstore (venezia), com.amazon.tv.oobe, com.amazon.tv.matter
(Matter casting), com.amazon.providers.contentsupport (switches the TTS engine Alexa uses), accessibility (logan).
Applied 2026-10-21 in four batches with a screenshot after each, then rebooted: all 45 stayed disabled, Home and
YouTube work. Alexa was kept, so nothing came back at boot.
The hero banner on Home is the launcher's own feed and stays; the recommendation rows under it are gone.
Looked at and left alone, role unclear: com.amazon.ale, katoch, spiderpork, tv.arc, securitysyncclient, device.details,
tv.fss, neodelegate, sharingservice proxy, cpl, tifobserver, connectivitydiag, neopactservice, dpcclient, mediatek.*.
